dcweventregister-form-name: Label for the name field on the registration form
dcweventregister-form-email: Label for the email field on the registration form
dcweventregister-form-submit: Label for the submit button on the registration form
dcweventregister-success: Message shown after a successful registration
dcweventregister-error-invalid-email: Error shown when the submitted email address is not valid
dcweventregister-error-duplicate: Error shown when the user has already registered for this event
dcweventregister-email-confirmation-subj: Subject line of the confirmation email. $1 is the event name
dcweventregister-email-confirmation-body: Body of the confirmation email. $1 is the user's name, $2 is the event name, $3 is the event date/time
dcweventregister-email-reminder-subject: Subject line of the reminder email. $1 is the event name
dcweventregister-email-reminder-body: Body of the reminder email. $1 is the user's name, $2 is the event name, $3 is the event date/time
